newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Lagoven ups liquid natural gas output.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Lagoven ups liquid natural gas output.

text.p: Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) unit Lagoven said it plans to increase its output of liquid natural gas to 86,000 barrels per day (bpd) by the end of 1998, nearly double the average 1996 output of 48,000 bpd.
It said in a communique last year's output, up 2,000 bpd on 1995, was a record for the past 23 years.
The expected rise in production in the next two years will result, among other factors, from an upgrade of Acogas plant in eastern Venezuela that will bring an additional 23,000 bpd.
